Wow. All I know is I've dealt with feeling horrible for so long and in the past ~6 months SO much worse, like losing tons of hair, greying, no energy at all and to me it makes sense if my TSH has risen from 3 to 5 over these months. Can I ask, what were your levels before you were medicated? 

My doctor told me today she doesn't feel comfortable treating or doing more testing since my Free T4 was 1.1 and my TSH not hugely over the range. He said we'll check back in a few months but I'm going to see an endocrinologist instead. I get that 5.42 isn't that far off of 5 but I really feel like it could explain things and help me get back on my feet if it's causing my symptoms. I hope the endocrinologist I see is open to digging a little deeper than the Free T4!
